title: Legacy Space Home editing opens the canonical profile sidebar without discarding custom-page documents
detail: The legacy Home editor wrote pageDocs.home while the actual member profile arranged profileLayout, so edits could target an unused document. After the unchanged visibility, page identity and manage/staff-preview gates, Home now redirects to the canonical profile with edit=page. Only its server-authorized owner preview mounts the launcher, with the actual Space ID/type rather than query-supplied authority. Desktop and mobile sidebar bodies consume the typed appId by focusing the existing permitted Page node; unknown or hidden apps cannot create editors. The Frequency overview uses this canonical entry. Explicit custom ?page edits retain their original pageDocs identity and staff read-only previews. No stored content, underlying actions, block types or website editor was deleted. Full compatibility retirement remains conditional on a pageDocs sidebar adapter because custom pages and website fallbacks still consume those documents. Focused mocked gate/redirect/launch/focus tests pass; authenticated localhost browser behavior awaits the next integration build.
